newsitem.title: SPAIN: NO COMMENT ON ALLEGED UNISOURCE PAYOFF- TELEFONICA.
newsitem.headline: NO COMMENT ON ALLEGED UNISOURCE PAYOFF- TELEFONICA.

text.p: Spain's Telefonica declined to comment on Tuesday about a newspaper report that it paid Unisource 18 billion pesetas in order to split with the telecoms consortium.
"We have no comment on the subject," a spokesman at the Spanish firm said.
According to financial daily Cinco Dias, Telefonica would buy out its subsidiary Telefonica Transmision de Datos (TTD) from the consortium and would give up its 25 percent stake in Unisource.
This would cost 18 billion pesetas overall after the price of both purchases had been updated.
After Telefonica announced an international alliance with British Telecom and MCI Communications Corp in April, Unisource asked the Spanish operator to leave.
Unisource comprises Holland's KPN , Swiss Telecom PTT and Switzerland's Telia, and in turn has a venture with U.S. giant AT&T , making it a rival to the BT-MCI alliance.
